changes: Retains six sampler Machines, Recorder, explicit FORMAT SAMPLES setup and 42-channel USB audio.
Sound-lock-aware sample usage and restoration references; per-Machine held-trig edits; rejected slice splits preserve markers.
Native sampler SYN copy/paste/clear/undo/randomize and FUNC controls; held-trig sample bank display; occupied-slot sample selection.
Stricter sample header/read validation and staged replacement preserve resident audio on rejected replacements; Recorder assignment failures preserve the original Sound.
SLICE note/span and reverse-loop bounds; held voices retire safely when a replacement sample becomes shorter; short-sample STRETCH grain offsets remain within the asset.
All six samplers use CC 40–47 and NRPN 1:73–80 for SYN controls. SAMP CC43 selects within the current bank; NRPN1:76 selects absolute positions 0–1023.
Bounds and failure handling for kit SysEx, song row counts, Euclidean rests and final timed outbound MIDI note release.

SLICE grids survive native same-device Sound/project save and reload via content-addressed companion files. Save failures propagate; failed new writes can retry; deferred restoration covers active tracks and preset-pool Sounds.

R020 fixes the R019 cold-start readiness defect: slice companion allocation/I/O waits for initialized filesystem startup status and mounted flag. DSP, USB ownership checks and control-frame ordering are unchanged from R019.

hardware_confirmed: Owner reports R020 cold boot with USB disconnected, saved 16-slice grid intact, normal UI and stock audio working.

On the R019 predecessor, read-only MIDI verified all 772 grid bytes, content key and sample identity after native project save, a different-project load and reload. Those warm tests did not cover cold boot.

Five bounded external-MIDI cases on R019 sent 48 note-ons across SLICE, FM TONE and mixed overlaps. USB MAIN and tested dry pairs settled to exact silence after release; no persistent note reproduced in that run. This does not establish internal-sequencer reliability.
offline_checked: Accumulated native-code regressions cover sampler UI controls, mixed Sound locks, sample references, staged replacements, slice/short-sample bounds, MIDI control maps and selected sequencer/SysEx paths. Detailed scope is documented in docs/research/2026-11-06.md.
R019 premature companion-file access reproduced with unstarted, mounting and failed startup states plus stale filesystem-ready memory.
R020 passes eight native Sound readiness cases: no heap allocation or file I/O before initialization, keys preserved, ready UI polling restores every grid byte, mounted save/load unchanged.

R020 fresh whole-project decode with poisoned readiness defers active/pool grids safely; post-mount restoration and re-save preserve the 12,890,116-byte serialized project exactly. Deferred aggregate save fails cleanly and retries successfully.
Native unpacking and early-startup checks pass both loader staging addresses with exact memory copies and preserved registers, stack and boot flags.
Independent startup-order/retry/ColdFire ABI review and package integrity checks pass; R020 DSP and protected sections match R019.
Fresh end-to-end public source build matches the pinned MAIN, expanded MAIN, runtime, DSP and SysEx identities; all 41 public unit tests pass.
Browser backend and actual browser UI/Worker/download each produce the pinned 2,570,912-byte SysEx; six Python recipe tests and JavaScript recipe boundary tests pass.
Independent publication review verifies authored adapter provenance, source-only payload boundaries and exclusion of private data.
pending: Repeated cold-boot endurance and power-loss behavior during writes.
Intermittent internal-sequencer stuck-note reproduction and long-duration audio/USB validation.
Full physical DT2 manual workflow coverage, real-time DMA/deadline guarantees and analog-output verification.
validation.notes: R020 is a candidate with targeted owner-reported cold-boot success. R012 remains stable. The premature-I/O defect is proven in native-code fixtures; the exact original physical black-screen cause was not captured. R019 is held and is not offered by the online builder.

source_reproduction.notes: Fresh public-source reconstruction rebuilt all required MAIN/DSP stages from the two official OS inputs and generated silence. Source, browser backend and actual browser Worker/download independently produced the pinned R020 SysEx. No private bank, historical custom firmware or device capture was used as a build input.

known_issues: Native Sound/project exports carry slice-grid keys, not the companion files. They are incomplete backups of slice edits; cross-device restore or formatting requires the companion files. Automatic bundling/restoration is not implemented.
Intermittent internal audio-track hung notes remain unresolved; the outbound MIDI expiry fix is a separate path.
Intermittent SAMP browser failures and physical USB/input artifacts have not been comprehensively resolved or attributed.
Bulk sample uploads/restoration can interrupt playback. Stop playback during transfers and wait until they finish; report problems that persist afterward.
A DSP transfer timeout can require restart even when the host retains the original sample binding.
Emulator instruction/model limits and filesystem/scheduler fixtures prevent treating offline results as complete hardware or manual compliance.
